AIReportResult.description:
Envelope for AI-layer reports (AnalysisResult-style).

Unlike the engine envelope, the subject may be a journal/performance
period rather than a market series, so ``generated_from`` is optional
and ``subject`` carries "SYMBOL/timeframe" or "journal:PERIOD".

generated_from.description: Market data window when the subject is a series.

AIReportResult.title: AIReportResult

config_overrides.description: Subset of EngineConfig fields; unknown keys are rejected (422).
config_overrides.title: Config Overrides

AnalysisResult.description:
Envelope wrapping every module's payload.

Consumers must check both ``schema_version`` (envelope/payload contract)
and ``engine_version`` (computation semantics) before interpreting the
payload.

run_id.description: Optional run-scoped bookkeeping ID (metadata only; not part of analytical equality).
run_id.title: Run Id

AnalysisResult.title: AnalysisResult

BacktestRequest.description: Backtest request: candles + strategy + config overrides.
BacktestRequest.title: BacktestRequest

BacktestResult.description: Complete backtest output: config echo, trades, equity, statistics.

backtest_config.description: Effective BacktestConfig dump used for the run (determinism echo).
backtest_config.title: Backtest Config

BacktestResult.title: BacktestResult

BacktestStatistics.description:
Aggregate performance metrics over the closed trades + equity curve.

Sharpe/Sortino use per-bar returns of the mark-to-market equity curve,
annualized by ``annualization_factor`` (bars per calendar year from the
timeframe, 365.25 days). Risk-free rate is 0 (configurable later).
Calmar = annualized return / max drawdown %. ``statistics_reliable`` is
False when total_trades < BacktestConfig.min_trades.

exposure_pct.description: Fraction of bars in a position.
exposure_pct.title: Exposure Pct

gross_loss.description: Absolute value of summed losing net PnL.
gross_loss.title: Gross Loss

profit_factor.description: gross_profit / gross_loss; None when no losses.
profit_factor.title: Profit Factor

sharpe.description: None when returns have zero std.
sharpe.title: Sharpe

statistics_reliable.description: total_trades >= config.min_trades; below that, metrics are noise.
statistics_reliable.title: Statistics Reliable

BacktestStatistics.title: BacktestStatistics

persist.description: Store the payload in the ResultStore.
persist.title: Persist

DataWindow.description:
The exact input-data window an analysis was generated from.

Timestamps always derive from candle data (never wall-clock) per the
determinism contract.
DataWindow.title: DataWindow

DrawdownInfo.description: Worst peak-to-trough decline of the mark-to-market equity curve.
DrawdownInfo.title: DrawdownInfo

EquityPoint.description: Mark-to-market equity at one bar close.

closed_equity.description: Realized equity after the last closed trade.
closed_equity.title: Closed Equity

equity.description: closed_equity + open PnL at this close.
equity.title: Equity

open_pnl.description: Unrealized PnL of the open position (0 when flat).
open_pnl.title: Open Pnl

EquityPoint.title: EquityPoint

ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope

StoredResultResponse.description: A persisted result with its full store key.

Timeframe.description:
Supported candle timeframes.

Values are the canonical string codes (``"1m"`` … ``"1M"``). Ordering is
by duration: ``M1 < M5 < H1 < D1 < W1 < MN1``.
Timeframe.title: Timeframe

initial_risk_distance.description: |entry - initial stop| in price; the 1R unit.
initial_risk_distance.title: Initial Risk Distance

mae_price.description: Max adverse excursion in price while holding (intrabar path).
mae_price.title: Mae Price

stop_loss.description: Stop at exit time (breakeven may move it).
stop_loss.title: Stop Loss

TradeRecord.title: TradeRecord

TradeSetup.description: Caller-supplied proposed trade (input to trade evaluation).
TradeSetup.title: TradeSetup

TrendDirection.description: Directional state of price, a candle, or a structure leg.
TrendDirection.title: TrendDirection

VersionedModel.description:
Base for all versioned, serializable models.

Subclasses set ``SCHEMA_VERSION``; the ``schema_version`` field defaults
to it and rejects mismatched values, so payloads can never silently drift
from the class that validates them.
VersionedModel.title: VersionedModel
